name: hr_leave_ledger
summary: Transactional leave balances, accrual rules and reversals
description: Replaces the manual leave-balance pattern with an append-only ledger: accrual/usage/adjustment/reversal/carry-over entries, live balances derived from posted entries, half-day/hourly leave, automatic period accrual (with carry-over cap and expiry configuration) and posting driven by the existing allocation/request approval workflow. Extends the hr anchor without migrating its tables; navigated under the single HR app.
author: Nexa
